output.subject: fast pipeline for Acme Close
output.body:
Acme Fintech launched Acme Close on 24 September 2026, a product that automates bank reconciliation and accruals to enable a three-day month-end close. That timing aligns with the challenge of scaling outbound pipeline without adding SDR headcount, as generic sequences see falling reply rates. Would you be open to a 15-minute call to explore how Halyard can feed qualified buyer accounts to accelerate Acme Close adoption?

Priyanshu
